<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">

<head>

    <!-- BASIC -->
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <link rel="canonical" href="https://appexproductions.com/">
    <meta name="robots" content="index, follow">

    <!-- TITLE -->
    <title>Production House in Kashmir | Appex Productions</title>

    <!-- PRELOAD: LCP Assets -->
    <link rel="preload" as="image" href="https://i.ibb.co/bM6jSmvJ/logo-removebg-preview.png" fetchpriority="high"
        type="image/webp">
    <link rel="preload" as="video" href="images/home.webm" type="video/webm">

    <!-- SEO DESCRIPTION -->
    <meta name="description"
        content="Appex Productions is a Kashmir-based production house offering film, music, video, AI, photography and creative production services. Based in Srinagar, J&K.">

    <!-- OPEN GRAPH / FACEBOOK -->
    <meta property="og:type" content="website">
    <meta property="og:url" content="https://appexproductions.com/">
    <meta property="og:title" content="Production House in Kashmir | Appex Productions">
    <meta property="og:description"
        content="Appex Productions is a Kashmir-based production house offering film, music, video, AI, photography and creative production services.">
    <meta property="og:image" content="https://appexproductions.com/images/bts1.webp">

    <!-- TWITTER -->
    <meta property="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image">
    <meta property="twitter:url" content="https://appexproductions.com/">
    <meta property="twitter:title" content="Production House in Kashmir | Appex Productions">
    <meta property="twitter:description"
        content="Appex Productions is a Kashmir-based production house offering film, music, video, AI, photography and creative production services.">
    <meta property="twitter:image" content="https://appexproductions.com/images/bts1.webp">

    <!-- JSON-LD SCHEMA
         @id gives the organisation a stable identifier that other pages and
         schema blocks can reference, so search and AI engines resolve every
         mention to one entity instead of several look-alike companies. -->
    <script type="application/ld+json">
    {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "ProductionCompany",
      "@id": "https://appexproductions.com/#organization",
      "name": "Appex Productions",
      "alternateName": "Appex",
      "url": "https://appexproductions.com/",
      "logo": "https://appexproductions.com/images/logo-512.webp",
      "image": "https://appexproductions.com/images/logo-512.webp",
      "description": "Appex Productions is a creative production agency based in Srinagar, Jammu & Kashmir, India, providing film and video production, music and audio production, photography and drone cinematography, web and app development, digital marketing, graphic design, outdoor advertising, and architectural design and land survey services for clients in Kashmir and internationally.",
      "slogan": "Forging narratives that resonate.",
      "email": "info@appexproductions.com",
      "telephone": "+91-78894-20003",
      "contactPoint": [
        {
          "@type": "ContactPoint",
          "email": "info@appexproductions.com",
          "telephone": "+91-78894-20003",
          "contactType": "customer service",
          "areaServed": "Worldwide",
          "availableLanguage": ["en"]
        }
      ],
      "address": {
        "@type": "PostalAddress",
        "streetAddress": "NH 1, Opposite Fruit Mandi, Parimpora",
        "addressLocality": "Srinagar",
        "addressRegion": "Jammu and Kashmir",
        "postalCode": "190017",
        "addressCountry": "IN"
      },
      "geo": {
        "@type": "GeoCoordinates",
        "latitude": 34.097161,
        "longitude": 74.758294
      },
      "areaServed": [
        { "@type": "Place", "name": "Jammu & Kashmir, India" },
        { "@type": "Country", "name": "India" }
      ],
      "knowsAbout": [
        "Cinematic video production",
        "Commercial and brand film production",
        "Corporate film production",
        "Documentary filmmaking",
        "Multi-camera studio and live event production",
        "Film and video editing",
        "Motion graphics",
        "Drone cinematography and aerial photography",
        "Event photography",
        "Real estate photography",
        "Pre-wedding photography",
        "Music production and composition",
        "Film scores and background music",
        "Sonic branding and jingles",
        "Audio mixing and mastering",
        "Voice-over production and ADR",
        "Sound design and Foley recording",
        "Game audio",
        "Podcast production",
        "Custom web development",
        "Mobile app development",
        "UI/UX design",
        "Digital marketing and performance marketing",
        "Social media management",
        "Search engine optimisation and generative engine optimisation",
        "Graphic design, logo design and brand identity",
        "Billboard, hoarding and digital LED advertising",
        "Architectural design and planning",
        "Interior and exterior design",
        "Land survey, estimation and valuation"
      ],
      "makesOffer": [
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Film & Video Production" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Post-Production & Motion Graphics" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "AI Creative Studio (AI Images, Videos, Audio & Virtual Humans)" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Photography & Drone Cinematography" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Music Production" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Audio Engineering & Post-Production" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Podcast Production" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Web & App Development" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "UI/UX Design" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Digital Marketing, SEO & GEO" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Graphic Design & Branding" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Outdoor & LED Advertising" } },
        { "@type": "Offer", "itemOffered": { "@type": "Service", "name": "Architecture, Land Survey & Valuation" } }
      ],
      "sameAs": [
        "https://www.facebook.com/appex.productions",
        "https://x.com/appexproduction",
        "https://www.instagram.com/appex.productions",
        "https://www.youtube.com/@Appex-Productions",
        "https://www.linkedin.com/company/appex-productions/"
      ]
    }
    </script>

    <!-- WEBSITE ENTITY — ties every page back to the organisation above -->
    <script type="application/ld+json">
    {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "WebSite",
      "@id": "https://appexproductions.com/#website",
      "url": "https://appexproductions.com/",
      "name": "Appex Productions",
      "inLanguage": "en",
      "publisher": { "@id": "https://appexproductions.com/#organization" }
    }
    </script>

    <!-- FAVICONS (Google Search & Browser Compatibility) -->
    <link rel="icon" type="image/webp" sizes="32x32" href="images/favicon-32.webp">
    <link rel="icon" type="image/webp" sizes="192x192" href="images/favicon-192.webp">
    <link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="images/apple-touch-icon.webp">

    <!-- PWA MANIFEST -->
    <link rel="manifest" href="manifest.json">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#ff3e3e">

    <!-- CSS -->
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/style.min.css?v=155">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/aesthetic.css?v=155">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css">

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link
        href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Dancing+Script:wght@700&family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap"
        rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        /* BASE STYLES */
        html, body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
        }

        body {
            background-color: #050505;
            color: #ffffff;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }


        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .oo-watermark-ticker-wrap,
            .pg-watermark-ticker-wrap,
            .lw-watermark-ticker-wrap,
            .sv-watermark-ticker-wrap,
            .bts-watermark-ticker-wrap {
                display: none !important;
            }
        }

        /* HEADER - PREMIUM 3-COLUMN LAYOUT */
        .site-header {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 1000;
            background: transparent;
            transition: 0.4s;
        }

        .header-top {
            padding: 20px 0;
            transition: 0.4s;
        }

        .header-top .container-fluid {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 60px;
        }

        .top-left,
        .top-right {
            display: flex;
            gap: 25px;
            align-items: center;
            flex: 1;
        }

        .top-right {
            justify-content: flex-end;
        }

        .top-center {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .brand-link {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        .brand-link img {
            height: 42px;
            width: auto;
            transition: height 0.3s;
        }

        .brand-link span {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 800;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            color: #fff;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .brand-link strong {
            color: #bc0000;
        }

        .top-left a,
        .header-social-link {
            color: #ffffff !important;
            font-size: 16px;
            transition: 0.3s;
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            border-radius: 50%;
            text-decoration: none;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        }

        .top-left a:hover {
            color: #fff !important;
            background: #bc0000;
            transform: translateY(-3px) scale(1.1);
            box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(188, 0, 0, 0.4);
        }

        .header-contact-link {
            color: #fff;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 600;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 7px;
        }

        .header-contact-link i {
            color: #bc0000;
        }

        /* DROPDOWN NAVIGATION (PREMIUM GLASSMORPHISM) */
        .desktop-nav ul li.dropdown {
            position: relative;
        }

        /* Dropdown Bridge (Prevents hover gap loss) */
        .desktop-nav ul li.dropdown::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 100%;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 25px;
        }

        .desktop-nav ul li.dropdown .dropdown-content {
            display: block;
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(100% + 20px);
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(15px);
            min-width: 200px;
            background: rgba(8, 11, 20, 0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(180%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-top: 2px solid #ff0000;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9), 0 0 30px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1);
            border-radius: 8px;
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            padding: 12px 0;
            z-index: 1001;
            transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
        }

        .desktop-nav ul li.dropdown:hover .dropdown-content {
            opacity: 1;
            visibility: visible;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
        }

        .desktop-nav ul li.dropdown .dropdown-content a {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7) !important;
            padding: 14px 25px !important;
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 13px !important;
            font-weight: 700 !important;
            text-align: left;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px !important;
            text-transform: uppercase !important;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: flex-start !important;
            transition: all 0.3s ease !important;
            border-left: 2px solid transparent;
        }

        .desktop-nav ul li.dropdown .dropdown-content a:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1) 0%, transparent 100%);
            color: #fff !important;
            border-left: 2px solid #ff0000;
            padding-left: 32px !important;
        }

        /* Chevron animation */
        .desktop-nav ul li.dropdown>a i {
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            font-size: 10px;
            margin-left: 6px;
        }

        .desktop-nav ul li.dropdown:hover>a i {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
        }

        /* HERO SECTION */
        .hero {
            position: relative;
            /* header.html pulls every hero up by 80px (margin-top:-80px), so the
               box must be 80px taller to still reach the bottom of the viewport */
            height: calc(100vh + 80px);
            min-height: calc(100vh + 80px);
            width: 100%;
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: center;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: #000;
            padding-bottom: 8vh;
        }

        .hero-bg-container {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            z-index: 1;
            height: 100%;
        }

        .hero-poster {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
        }

        .hero-video-bg {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            z-index: 2;
            transition: opacity 0.5s ease-out;
        }

        .hero-reveal-box {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 10;
            text-align: center;
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 1200px;
            transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease, visibility 0.4s ease;
            opacity: 0;
            visibility: hidden;
            transform: translateY(40px);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .top-vignette {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 250px;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8) 0%, transparent 100%);
            z-index: 5;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .desktop-nav ul {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 35px;
            padding: 13px 0;
            margin: 0;
        }

        .desktop-nav a {
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
            text-decoration: none;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            transition: 0.3s;
        }

        .desktop-nav a:hover {
            color: #bc0000;
        }

        .site-header.scrolled {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        }

        /* MOBILE HEADER REFINEMENT */
        @media (max-width: 992px) {

            .top-left,
            .top-right {
                display: none !important;
            }

            .site-header {
                width: 94% !important;
                left: 3% !important;
                top: 15px !important;
                background: rgba(13, 18, 28, 0.7) !important;
                backdrop-filter: blur(15px) saturate(180%) !important;
                -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px) saturate(180%) !important;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) !important;
                border-radius: 100px !important;
                box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) !important;
            }

            .header-top {
                padding: 0 !important;
                min-height: 65px !important;
            }

            .header-top .container-fluid {
                display: flex !important;
                justify-content: center !important;
                align-items: center !important;
                padding: 0 20px !important;
                position: relative !important;
                height: 100% !important;
            }

            .top-center {
                flex: 1 !important;
                display: flex !important;
                justify-content: center !important;
                align-items: center !important;
            }

            .brand-link {
                gap: 8px !important;
                margin: 0 !important;
                display: flex !important;
                align-items: center !important;
            }

            .brand-link img {
                height: 28px !important;
            }

            .brand-link span {
                font-size: 13px !important;
                letter-spacing: 0.5px !important;
                white-space: nowrap !important;
                line-height: 1 !important;
            }

            .brand-link strong {
                color: #ff3e3e !important;
            }

            .header-bottom {
                display: none !important;
            }
        }

        .btn-primary {
            display: inline-block;
            padding: 16px 45px;
            background: #bc0000;
            color: #fff;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-radius: 50px;
            font-weight: 700;
            transition: 0.4s;
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(188, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(188, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }

        [data-reveal] {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(30px);
            transition: 1s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1);
        }

        [data-reveal].visible {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        /* HERO TICKER */
        .hero-ticker {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #12060700, #170708 30%, #170708 70%, #12060700);
            border-top: 1px solid rgba(229, 9, 20, .3);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(229, 9, 20, .3);
            padding: 18px 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            z-index: 20;
            display: flex;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .ticker-content {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            animation: tickerScroll 30s linear infinite;
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 54px);
            letter-spacing: -.02em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .ticker-content span {
            padding: 0 20px;
            color: transparent;
            -webkit-text-stroke: 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, .34);
        }

        .ticker-content i {
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #e50914;
            -webkit-text-stroke: 0;
        }

        @keyframes tickerScroll {
            0% {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }

            100% {
                transform: translateX(-50%);
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .ticker-content {
                animation: none !important;
            }
        }

        /* ── INTRO SECTION ── */
        .intro-section {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 15;
            padding: 70px 30px;
            background: #060608;
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            overflow: hidden;
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        .intro-container {
            max-width: 880px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .intro-text {
            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.85;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
            margin: 0 auto 26px;
            max-width: 820px;
            letter-spacing: 0.2px;
        }

        .intro-links {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .intro-links-label {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
            margin-right: 4px;
        }

        .intro-pill {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 8px 18px;
            border-radius: 50px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.25);
            color: #f0f0f5;
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
            text-decoration: none;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;
        }

        .intro-pill:hover {
            background: rgba(188, 0, 0, 0.2);
            border-color: #ff3e3e;
            color: #ffffff;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.25);
        }

        .intro-pill i {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #ff3e3e;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .intro-pill:hover i {
            transform: translateX(3px);
        }

        /* SECTIONS STYLES */
        .partners-track img {
            height: 130px;
            width: auto;
        }

        .stats-section {
            padding: 100px 20px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #050505 0%, #0a0a0c 100%);
            border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
        }

        .stats-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
            gap: 30px;
            max-width: 1200px;
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        .stat-card {
            background: rgba(18, 18, 22, 0.6);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 40px 30px;
            text-align: center;
            transition: 0.4s;
            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .stat-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-10px);
            border-color: rgba(188, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }

        .stat-number {
            font-size: 3.5rem;
            font-weight: 900;
            color: #fff;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        /* HERO RESPONSIVE TYPOGRAPHY */
        .hero-text-wrapper h1 {
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 8vw, 4.2rem) !important;
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: 0 auto 25px;
            line-height: 1.1;
        }

        .hero-text-wrapper p {
            font-size: clamp(0.85rem, 2vw, 1.2rem) !important;
        }

        .hero-eyebrow {
            color: #bc0000;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 3px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            margin-bottom: 15px;
        }

        .text-accent {
            color: #ff3e3e !important;
            font-family: 'Dancing Script', cursive !important;
            text-transform: none !important;
            font-size: 1.25em !important;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.4) !important;
            display: inline-block;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .mobile-hide {
                display: none !important;
            }

            .hero {
                position: relative !important;
                top: auto !important;
                z-index: 5;
                align-items: center !important;
                padding-bottom: 70px !important;
                padding-top: 0 !important;
                height: 100vh !important;
                min-height: 520px !important;
                background: #000;
                overflow: hidden !important;
                width: 100% !important;
                max-width: 100vw !important;
            }

            .hero-ticker {
                position: absolute !important;
                bottom: 0 !important;
                left: 0 !important;
                width: 100% !important;
                overflow: hidden !important;
                padding: 10px 0 !important;
                z-index: 15 !important;

                display: block;

                left: 0;
                transform-origin: center;
                will-change: transform, opacity, top;
            }

            /* top bar */
            .line-1 {
                width: 100%;
                top: 0;
                transition:
                    top 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.1s,
                    transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 0s,

                width: 60%;

            /* ── ACTIVE: bars morph into × ── */
            .menu-toggle.active .line-1 {
                top: 6px;

                background: #ff3e3e;

    <script>
        // Universal Two-Sided Showcase Stack Controller
        function setupShowcaseStack({
            deckId,
            cardSelector,
            listId,
            rowSelector,
            bridgeId,
            lineId,
            indicatorId,
            prevBtnId,
            nextBtnId,
            autoCycle = true
        }) {
            const deck = document.getElementById(deckId);
            const list = document.getElementById(listId);
            const bridge = document.getElementById(bridgeId);
            const line = document.getElementById(lineId);
            const indicator = document.getElementById(indicatorId);
            const prevBtn = document.getElementById(prevBtnId);
            const nextBtn = document.getElementById(nextBtnId);

            if (!deck || !list) return;

            let cards = Array.from(deck.querySelectorAll(cardSelector));
            let rows = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll(rowSelector));
            const total = Math.min(cards.length, rows.length);
            if (total === 0) return;

            let currentIndex = 0;
            let autoTimer = null;

            function updateConnector() {
                if (!bridge || !line || window.innerWidth <= 992) return;
                const activeRow = rows[currentIndex];
                if (!activeRow) return;
                const bridgeRect = bridge.getBoundingClientRect();
                const rowRect = activeRow.getBoundingClientRect();
                const targetY = (rowRect.top + rowRect.height / 2) - bridgeRect.top;
                line.style.top = `${targetY}px`;
            }

            function setIndex(index) {
                currentIndex = (index + total) % total;

                // Position cards in 3D stack
                cards.forEach((card, i) => {
                    card.classList.remove('pos-0', 'pos-1', 'pos-2', 'pos-hidden');
                    const offset = (i - currentIndex + total) % total;
                    if (offset === 0) {
                        card.classList.add('pos-0');
                    } else if (offset === 1) {
                        card.classList.add('pos-1');
                    } else if (offset === 2) {
                        card.classList.add('pos-2');
                    } else {
                        card.classList.add('pos-hidden');
                    }
                });

                // Update directory rows
                rows.forEach((row, i) => {
                    if (i === currentIndex) {
                        row.classList.add('active');
                    } else {
                        row.classList.remove('active');
                    }
                });

                if (list.scrollHeight > list.clientHeight && rows[currentIndex]) {
                    rows[currentIndex].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
                }

                // Update counter indicator
                if (indicator) {
                    const curStr = (currentIndex + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    const totStr = total.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    indicator.textContent = `${curStr} / ${totStr}`;
                }

                setTimeout(updateConnector, 40);
            }

            // Bind list row hover and click
            rows.forEach((row, i) => {
                row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => setIndex(i));
                row.addEventListener('click', () => setIndex(i));
            });

            // Bind stack card clicks
            cards.forEach((card, i) => {
                card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (!card.classList.contains('pos-0')) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        setIndex(i);
                    }
                });
            });

            // Bind navigation buttons
            if (prevBtn) {
                prevBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setIndex(currentIndex - 1);
                };
            }
            if (nextBtn) {
                nextBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setIndex(currentIndex + 1);
                };
            }

            // Auto-cycle logic
            const container = deck.closest('.pg-showcase, .lw-showcase');
            const startAuto = () => {
                stopAuto();
                if (autoCycle && total > 1) {
                    autoTimer = setInterval(() => {
                        setIndex(currentIndex + 1);
                    }, 5000);
                }
            };
            const stopAuto = () => {
                if (autoTimer) clearInterval(autoTimer);
            };

            if (container) {
                container.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAuto);
                container.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAuto);
            }

            window.addEventListener('resize', updateConnector);

            setIndex(0);
            startAuto();
        }

        // Render dynamic Latest Works into showcase structure
        function renderLatestWorksShowcase(data) {
            const deck = document.getElementById('lwStackDeck');
            const list = document.getElementById('lwItemList');
            if (!deck || !list || !data || data.length === 0) return;

            deck.innerHTML = '';
            list.innerHTML = '';

            data.forEach((work, i) => {
                const num = (i + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
                const targetUrl = work.link || '#';
                const isInsta = targetUrl.includes('instagram.com');
                const isYt = targetUrl.includes('youtu');

                let tag = 'Featured';
                const lowerTitle = (work.title || '').toLowerCase();
                if (lowerTitle.includes('documentary')) tag = 'Documentary';
                else if (lowerTitle.includes('commercial') || lowerTitle.includes('retail') || lowerTitle.includes('ad')) tag = 'Commercial';
                else if (lowerTitle.includes('food') || lowerTitle.includes('restaurant') || lowerTitle.includes('court')) tag = 'Brand Film';
                else if (lowerTitle.includes('podcast')) tag = 'Podcast';
                else if (lowerTitle.includes('vlog')) tag = 'Vlog';
                else if (isInsta) tag = 'Reel';
                else if (isYt) tag = '4K Video';

                const platformHtml = isInsta 
                    ? '<i class="fab fa-instagram" style="color: #e1306c;"></i> Instagram Reel' 
                    : (isYt ? '<i class="fab fa-youtube" style="color: #ff3e3e;"></i> YouTube Video' : '<i class="fas fa-play" style="color: #ff3e3e;"></i> Project');

                const safeTitle = (work.title || 'Creative Project').replace(/"/g, '"');
                const posClass = i === 0 ? 'pos-0' : (i === 1 ? 'pos-1' : (i === 2 ? 'pos-2' : 'pos-hidden'));

                // Build deck card
                deck.innerHTML += `
                    <a href="${targetUrl}" class="lw-stack-card ${posClass}" data-index="${i}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                        <div class="lw-card-media">
                            <img src="${work.thumbnail_path}" alt="" class="lw-card-bg-blur" aria-hidden="true" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
                            <img src="${work.thumbnail_path}" alt="${safeTitle}" class="lw-card-img" width="1280" height="720" onerror="this.src='images/bts1.webp'">
                            <div class="lw-card-badges">
                                <span class="lw-card-badge-num">PROJ ${num}</span>
                                <span class="lw-card-badge-tag">${tag}</span>
                            </div>

                        <div class="lw-item-content">
                            <div class="lw-item-header">

                                <span class="lw-item-tag">${tag}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="lw-item-action">
                                <a href="${targetUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="lw-item-watch-btn">View Project <i class="fas fa-arrow-right"></i></a>
                                <span class="lw-item-platform">${platformHtml}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            const indicator = document.getElementById('lwStackIndicator');
            if (indicator) {
                indicator.textContent = `01 / ${data.length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
            }

            setupShowcaseStack({
                deckId: 'lwStackDeck',
                cardSelector: '.lw-stack-card',
                listId: 'lwItemList',
                rowSelector: '.lw-item-row',
                bridgeId: 'lwConnectorBridge',
                lineId: 'lwConnectorLine',
                indicatorId: 'lwStackIndicator',
                prevBtnId: 'lwPrevBtn',
                nextBtnId: 'lwNextBtn',
                autoCycle: true
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Initialize Original Shows Showcase
            setupShowcaseStack({
                deckId: 'pgStackDeck',
                cardSelector: '.pg-stack-card',
                listId: 'pgItemList',
                rowSelector: '.pg-item-row',
                bridgeId: 'pgConnectorBridge',
                lineId: 'pgConnectorLine',
                indicatorId: 'pgStackIndicator',
                prevBtnId: 'pgPrevBtn',
                nextBtnId: 'pgNextBtn',
                autoCycle: true
            });

            // Initialize Latest Works Showcase (Fetch from Database, or use Fallback)
            fetch('admin/latest_work_actions.php?action=fetch')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data && data.length > 0) {
                        renderLatestWorksShowcase(data);
                    } else {
                        setupShowcaseStack({
                            deckId: 'lwStackDeck',
                            cardSelector: '.lw-stack-card',
                            listId: 'lwItemList',
                            rowSelector: '.lw-item-row',
                            bridgeId: 'lwConnectorBridge',
                            lineId: 'lwConnectorLine',
                            indicatorId: 'lwStackIndicator',
                            prevBtnId: 'lwPrevBtn',
                            nextBtnId: 'lwNextBtn',
                            autoCycle: true
                        });
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    console.error('Error fetching Latest Works:', err);
                    setupShowcaseStack({
                        deckId: 'lwStackDeck',
                        cardSelector: '.lw-stack-card',
                        listId: 'lwItemList',
                        rowSelector: '.lw-item-row',
                        bridgeId: 'lwConnectorBridge',
                        lineId: 'lwConnectorLine',
                        indicatorId: 'lwStackIndicator',
                        prevBtnId: 'lwPrevBtn',
                        nextBtnId: 'lwNextBtn',
                        autoCycle: true
                    });
                });

            // 2. Fetch BTS
            fetch('admin/bts_actions.php?action=fetch')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    const imgContainer = document.getElementById('dynamic-bts-images');
                    const vidContainer = document.getElementById('dynamic-bts-videos');
                    if (data && data.length > 0) {
                        if (imgContainer) imgContainer.innerHTML = '';
                        if (vidContainer) vidContainer.innerHTML = '';

                        let imgCount = 0;
                        let vidCount = 0;
                        data.forEach(item => {
                            if (item.type === 'image' && imgCount < 3) {
                                if (imgContainer) {
                                    imgContainer.innerHTML += `
                                        <div class="bts-item-card bts-img-trigger">
                                            <img src="${item.media_path}" alt="${item.title}" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
                                            <div class="bts-i-overlay">
                                                <div class="bts-v-icon"><i class="fas fa-expand"></i></div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    `;
                                }
                                imgCount++;
                            } else if (item.type === 'video' && vidCount < 3) {
                                if (vidContainer) {
                                    vidContainer.innerHTML += `
                                        <div class="bts-item-card bts-video-trigger" data-src="${item.media_path}">
                                            <video src="${item.media_path}" muted></video>
                                            <div class="bts-i-overlay">
                                                <div class="bts-v-icon"><i class="fas fa-play"></i></div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    `;
                                }
                                vidCount++;
                            }
                        });

                        // 3. Modal logic for BTS
                        const modal = document.getElementById("btsModal");
                        const mImg = document.getElementById("btsModalImg");
                        const mVid = document.getElementById("btsModalVideo");
                        const prevBtn = document.querySelector(".bts-prev");
                        const nextBtn = document.querySelector(".bts-next");

                        if (modal && mImg && mVid) {
                            // Close modal on click outside or close button
                            const closeBtn = document.querySelector(".bts-close");
                            const hideArrows = () => {
                                if (prevBtn) prevBtn.style.display = "none";
                                if (nextBtn) nextBtn.style.display = "none";
                            };

                            if (closeBtn) {
                                closeBtn.onclick = () => {
                                    modal.classList.remove("active");
                                    document.body.style.overflow = "";
                                    mVid.pause(); mVid.src = "";
                                    hideArrows();
                                };
                            }
                            modal.onclick = (e) => {
                                if (e.target === modal) {
                                    modal.classList.remove("active");
                                    document.body.style.overflow = "";
                                    mVid.pause(); mVid.src = "";
                                    hideArrows();
                                }
                            };

                            let imageGallery = [];
                            document.querySelectorAll(".bts-img-trigger img").forEach(img => {
                                imageGallery.push(img.src);
                            });
                            let currentImageIndex = 0;

                            if (prevBtn && nextBtn) {
                                prevBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    currentImageIndex = (currentImageIndex - 1 + imageGallery.length) % imageGallery.length;
                                    mImg.src = imageGallery[currentImageIndex];
                                };
                                nextBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    currentImageIndex = (currentImageIndex + 1) % imageGallery.length;
                                    mImg.src = imageGallery[currentImageIndex];
                                };
                            }

                            document.querySelectorAll(".bts-img-trigger").forEach((el, index) => {
                                el.addEventListener("click", () => {
                                    currentImageIndex = index;
                                    modal.classList.add("active");
                                    mImg.src = imageGallery[currentImageIndex];
                                    mImg.style.display = "block";
                                    mVid.pause(); mVid.src = ""; mVid.style.display = "none";
                                    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

                                    if (imageGallery.length > 1) {
                                        if (prevBtn) prevBtn.style.display = "flex";
                                        if (nextBtn) nextBtn.style.display = "flex";
                                    }
                                });
                            });

                            document.querySelectorAll(".bts-video-trigger").forEach(el => {
                                el.addEventListener("click", () => {
                                    modal.classList.add("active");
                                    mVid.src = el.dataset.src;
                                    mVid.style.display = "block";
                                    mVid.play();
                                    mImg.src = ""; mImg.style.display = "none";
                                    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
                                    hideArrows();
                                });
                            });
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => console.error('Error fetching BTS:', err));

            // 4. Tab Switching Logic
            const btsTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.bts-t-btn');
            btsTabs.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    btsTabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                    btn.classList.add('active');
                    const target = btn.dataset.target;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.bts-panel').forEach(p => {
                        p.style.display = 'none';
                        p.classList.remove('active');
                    });
                    const targetPanel = document.getElementById(target);
                    if (targetPanel) {
                        targetPanel.style.display = 'block';
                        setTimeout(() => targetPanel.classList.add('active'), 10);
                    }
                });
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // Intersection Observer for Videos (Preload only when near)
        const videoObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    const video = entry.target;
                    video.preload = "auto";
                    observer.unobserve(video);
                }
            });
        }, { rootMargin: "200px" });

        document.querySelectorAll('video[preload="metadata"]').forEach(video => {
            videoObserver.observe(video);
        });

        // REVEAL ON SCROLL
        const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.1 });

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));
    </script>

            /* ── MENU TOGGLE BUTTON ── */
            .menu-toggle {
                display: flex !important;
                position: absolute !important;
                right: 14px !important;
                top: 50% !important;
                transform: translateY(-50%) !important;
                width: 44px !important;
                height: 44px !important;
                align-items: center !important;
                justify-content: center !important;
                background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07) !important;
                border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.13) !important;
                border-radius: 12px !important;
                cursor: pointer !important;
                z-index: 10001 !important;
                overflow: hidden !important;
                transition:
                    background 0.35s ease,
                    border-color 0.35s ease,
                    border-radius 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1),
                    box-shadow 0.35s ease !important;
            }

            /* tap ripple */
            .menu-toggle::before {
                content: '';
                position: absolute;
                inset: 0;
                border-radius: inherit;
                background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.3) 0%, transparent 65%);
                opacity: 0;
                transform: scale(0.3);
                transition: opacity 0.45s ease, transform 0.45s ease;
                pointer-events: none;
            }

            .menu-toggle:active::before {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: scale(2.2);
                transition: opacity 0.05s, transform 0.05s;
            }

            .menu-toggle:hover {
                background: rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.1) !important;
                border-color: rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.28) !important;
            }

            /* OPEN state — pill becomes circle, glows */
            .menu-toggle.active {
                background: rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.13) !important;
                border-color: rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.5) !important;
                border-radius: 50% !important;
                box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.07),
                    0 0 22px rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.2) !important;
            }

            /* ── HAMBURGER BARS ── */
            .toggle-box {
                width: 20px;
                height: 14px;
                position: relative;
                pointer-events: none;
            }

            .toggle-box span {
                display: block;
                position: absolute;
                height: 2px;
                border-radius: 2px;
                background: #fff;
                left: 0;
                transform-origin: center;
                will-change: transform, opacity, top;
            }

            /* top bar */
            .line-1 {
                width: 100%;
                top: 0;
                transition:
                    top 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.1s,
                    transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 0s,
                    background 0.25s ease;
            }

            /* middle bar — shorter, right-aligned */
            .line-2 {
                width: 60%;
                top: 6px;
                right: 0;
                left: auto;
                transition:
                    opacity 0.18s ease,
                    transform 0.22s ease,
                    width 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            }

            /* bottom bar */
            .line-3 {
                width: 100%;
                top: 12px;
                transition:
                    top 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0.1s,
                    transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 0s,
                    background 0.25s ease;
            }

            /* hover: middle bar stretches full width */
            .menu-toggle:hover .line-2 {
                width: 100% !important;
            }

            /* ── ACTIVE: bars morph into × ── */
            .menu-toggle.active .line-1 {
                top: 6px;
                transform: rotate(45deg);
                background: #ff3e3e;
                width: 100%;
                transition:
                    top 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0s,
                    transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 0.1s,
                    background 0.25s ease;
            }

            .menu-toggle.active .line-2 {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: scaleX(0);
                transition: opacity 0.12s ease, transform 0.15s ease;
            }

            .menu-toggle.active .line-3 {
                top: 6px;
                transform: rotate(-45deg);
                background: #ff3e3e;
                transition:
                    top 0.28s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) 0s,
                    transform 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) 0.1s,
                    background 0.25s ease;
            }

    <script>
        // Universal Two-Sided Showcase Stack Controller
        function setupShowcaseStack({
            deckId,
            cardSelector,
            listId,
            rowSelector,
            bridgeId,
            lineId,
            indicatorId,
            prevBtnId,
            nextBtnId,
            autoCycle = true
        }) {
            const deck = document.getElementById(deckId);
            const list = document.getElementById(listId);
            const bridge = document.getElementById(bridgeId);
            const line = document.getElementById(lineId);
            const indicator = document.getElementById(indicatorId);
            const prevBtn = document.getElementById(prevBtnId);
            const nextBtn = document.getElementById(nextBtnId);

            if (!deck || !list) return;

            let cards = Array.from(deck.querySelectorAll(cardSelector));
            let rows = Array.from(list.querySelectorAll(rowSelector));
            const total = Math.min(cards.length, rows.length);
            if (total === 0) return;

            let currentIndex = 0;
            let autoTimer = null;

            function updateConnector() {
                if (!bridge || !line || window.innerWidth <= 992) return;
                const activeRow = rows[currentIndex];
                if (!activeRow) return;
                const bridgeRect = bridge.getBoundingClientRect();
                const rowRect = activeRow.getBoundingClientRect();
                const targetY = (rowRect.top + rowRect.height / 2) - bridgeRect.top;
                line.style.top = `${targetY}px`;
            }

            function setIndex(index) {
                currentIndex = (index + total) % total;

                // Position cards in 3D stack
                cards.forEach((card, i) => {
                    card.classList.remove('pos-0', 'pos-1', 'pos-2', 'pos-hidden');
                    const offset = (i - currentIndex + total) % total;
                    if (offset === 0) {
                        card.classList.add('pos-0');
                    } else if (offset === 1) {
                        card.classList.add('pos-1');
                    } else if (offset === 2) {
                        card.classList.add('pos-2');
                    } else {
                        card.classList.add('pos-hidden');
                    }
                });

                // Update directory rows
                rows.forEach((row, i) => {
                    if (i === currentIndex) {
                        row.classList.add('active');
                    } else {
                        row.classList.remove('active');
                    }
                });

                if (list.scrollHeight > list.clientHeight && rows[currentIndex]) {
                    rows[currentIndex].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
                }

                // Update counter indicator
                if (indicator) {
                    const curStr = (currentIndex + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    const totStr = total.toString().padStart(2, '0');
                    indicator.textContent = `${curStr} / ${totStr}`;
                }

                setTimeout(updateConnector, 40);
            }

            // Bind list row hover and click
            rows.forEach((row, i) => {
                row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => setIndex(i));
                row.addEventListener('click', () => setIndex(i));
            });

            // Bind stack card clicks
            cards.forEach((card, i) => {
                card.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    if (!card.classList.contains('pos-0')) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        setIndex(i);
                    }
                });
            });

            // Bind navigation buttons
            if (prevBtn) {
                prevBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setIndex(currentIndex - 1);
                };
            }
            if (nextBtn) {
                nextBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    setIndex(currentIndex + 1);
                };
            }

            // Auto-cycle logic
            const container = deck.closest('.pg-showcase, .lw-showcase');
            const startAuto = () => {
                stopAuto();
                if (autoCycle && total > 1) {
                    autoTimer = setInterval(() => {
                        setIndex(currentIndex + 1);
                    }, 5000);
                }
            };
            const stopAuto = () => {
                if (autoTimer) clearInterval(autoTimer);
            };

            if (container) {
                container.addEventListener('mouseenter', stopAuto);
                container.addEventListener('mouseleave', startAuto);
            }

            window.addEventListener('resize', updateConnector);

            setIndex(0);
            startAuto();
        }

        // Render dynamic Latest Works into showcase structure
        function renderLatestWorksShowcase(data) {
            const deck = document.getElementById('lwStackDeck');
            const list = document.getElementById('lwItemList');
            if (!deck || !list || !data || data.length === 0) return;

            deck.innerHTML = '';
            list.innerHTML = '';

            data.forEach((work, i) => {
                const num = (i + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0');
                const targetUrl = work.link || '#';
                const isInsta = targetUrl.includes('instagram.com');
                const isYt = targetUrl.includes('youtu');

                let tag = 'Featured';
                const lowerTitle = (work.title || '').toLowerCase();
                if (lowerTitle.includes('documentary')) tag = 'Documentary';
                else if (lowerTitle.includes('commercial') || lowerTitle.includes('retail') || lowerTitle.includes('ad')) tag = 'Commercial';
                else if (lowerTitle.includes('food') || lowerTitle.includes('restaurant') || lowerTitle.includes('court')) tag = 'Brand Film';
                else if (lowerTitle.includes('podcast')) tag = 'Podcast';
                else if (lowerTitle.includes('vlog')) tag = 'Vlog';
                else if (isInsta) tag = 'Reel';
                else if (isYt) tag = '4K Video';

                const platformHtml = isInsta 
                    ? '<i class="fab fa-instagram" style="color: #e1306c;"></i> Instagram Reel' 
                    : (isYt ? '<i class="fab fa-youtube" style="color: #ff3e3e;"></i> YouTube Video' : '<i class="fas fa-play" style="color: #ff3e3e;"></i> Project');

                const safeTitle = (work.title || 'Creative Project').replace(/"/g, '"');
                const posClass = i === 0 ? 'pos-0' : (i === 1 ? 'pos-1' : (i === 2 ? 'pos-2' : 'pos-hidden'));

                // Build deck card
                deck.innerHTML += `
                    <a href="${targetUrl}" class="lw-stack-card ${posClass}" data-index="${i}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                        <div class="lw-card-media">
                            <img src="${work.thumbnail_path}" alt="" class="lw-card-bg-blur" aria-hidden="true" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
                            <img src="${work.thumbnail_path}" alt="${safeTitle}" class="lw-card-img" width="1280" height="720" onerror="this.src='images/bts1.webp'">
                            <div class="lw-card-badges">
                                <span class="lw-card-badge-num">PROJ ${num}</span>
                                <span class="lw-card-badge-tag">${tag}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="lw-card-play"><div class="lw-card-play-btn"><i class="fas fa-play"></i></div></div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="lw-card-pin"></div>
                    </a>
                `;

                // Build directory row
                list.innerHTML += `
                    <div class="lw-item-row ${i === 0 ? 'active' : ''}" data-index="${i}">
                        <span class="lw-item-num">${num}</span>
                        <div class="lw-item-content">
                            <div class="lw-item-header">
                                <h4 class="lw-item-title">${safeTitle}</h4>
                                <span class="lw-item-tag">${tag}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="lw-item-action">
                                <a href="${targetUrl}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" class="lw-item-watch-btn">View Project <i class="fas fa-arrow-right"></i></a>
                                <span class="lw-item-platform">${platformHtml}</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            });

            const indicator = document.getElementById('lwStackIndicator');
            if (indicator) {
                indicator.textContent = `01 / ${data.length.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
            }

            setupShowcaseStack({
                deckId: 'lwStackDeck',
                cardSelector: '.lw-stack-card',
                listId: 'lwItemList',
                rowSelector: '.lw-item-row',
                bridgeId: 'lwConnectorBridge',
                lineId: 'lwConnectorLine',
                indicatorId: 'lwStackIndicator',
                prevBtnId: 'lwPrevBtn',
                nextBtnId: 'lwNextBtn',
                autoCycle: true
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Initialize Original Shows Showcase
            setupShowcaseStack({
                deckId: 'pgStackDeck',
                cardSelector: '.pg-stack-card',
                listId: 'pgItemList',
                rowSelector: '.pg-item-row',
                bridgeId: 'pgConnectorBridge',
                lineId: 'pgConnectorLine',
                indicatorId: 'pgStackIndicator',
                prevBtnId: 'pgPrevBtn',
                nextBtnId: 'pgNextBtn',
                autoCycle: true
            });

            // Initialize Latest Works Showcase (Fetch from Database, or use Fallback)
            fetch('admin/latest_work_actions.php?action=fetch')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data && data.length > 0) {
                        renderLatestWorksShowcase(data);
                    } else {
                        setupShowcaseStack({
                            deckId: 'lwStackDeck',
                            cardSelector: '.lw-stack-card',
                            listId: 'lwItemList',
                            rowSelector: '.lw-item-row',
                            bridgeId: 'lwConnectorBridge',
                            lineId: 'lwConnectorLine',
                            indicatorId: 'lwStackIndicator',
                            prevBtnId: 'lwPrevBtn',
                            nextBtnId: 'lwNextBtn',
                            autoCycle: true
                        });
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => {
                    console.error('Error fetching Latest Works:', err);
                    setupShowcaseStack({
                        deckId: 'lwStackDeck',
                        cardSelector: '.lw-stack-card',
                        listId: 'lwItemList',
                        rowSelector: '.lw-item-row',
                        bridgeId: 'lwConnectorBridge',
                        lineId: 'lwConnectorLine',
                        indicatorId: 'lwStackIndicator',
                        prevBtnId: 'lwPrevBtn',
                        nextBtnId: 'lwNextBtn',
                        autoCycle: true
                    });
                });

            // 2. Fetch BTS
            fetch('admin/bts_actions.php?action=fetch')
                .then(res => res.json())
                .then(data => {
                    const imgContainer = document.getElementById('dynamic-bts-images');
                    const vidContainer = document.getElementById('dynamic-bts-videos');
                    if (data && data.length > 0) {
                        if (imgContainer) imgContainer.innerHTML = '';
                        if (vidContainer) vidContainer.innerHTML = '';

                        let imgCount = 0;
                        let vidCount = 0;
                        data.forEach(item => {
                            if (item.type === 'image' && imgCount < 3) {
                                if (imgContainer) {
                                    imgContainer.innerHTML += `
                                        <div class="bts-item-card bts-img-trigger">
                                            <img src="${item.media_path}" alt="${item.title}" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
                                            <div class="bts-i-overlay">
                                                <div class="bts-v-icon"><i class="fas fa-expand"></i></div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    `;
                                }
                                imgCount++;
                            } else if (item.type === 'video' && vidCount < 3) {
                                if (vidContainer) {
                                    vidContainer.innerHTML += `
                                        <div class="bts-item-card bts-video-trigger" data-src="${item.media_path}">
                                            <video src="${item.media_path}" muted></video>
                                            <div class="bts-i-overlay">
                                                <div class="bts-v-icon"><i class="fas fa-play"></i></div>
                                            </div>
                                        </div>
                                    `;
                                }
                                vidCount++;
                            }
                        });

                        // 3. Modal logic for BTS
                        const modal = document.getElementById("btsModal");
                        const mImg = document.getElementById("btsModalImg");
                        const mVid = document.getElementById("btsModalVideo");
                        const prevBtn = document.querySelector(".bts-prev");
                        const nextBtn = document.querySelector(".bts-next");

                        if (modal && mImg && mVid) {
                            // Close modal on click outside or close button
                            const closeBtn = document.querySelector(".bts-close");
                            const hideArrows = () => {
                                if (prevBtn) prevBtn.style.display = "none";
                                if (nextBtn) nextBtn.style.display = "none";
                            };

                            if (closeBtn) {
                                closeBtn.onclick = () => {
                                    modal.classList.remove("active");
                                    document.body.style.overflow = "";
                                    mVid.pause(); mVid.src = "";
                                    hideArrows();
                                };
                            }
                            modal.onclick = (e) => {
                                if (e.target === modal) {
                                    modal.classList.remove("active");
                                    document.body.style.overflow = "";
                                    mVid.pause(); mVid.src = "";
                                    hideArrows();
                                }
                            };

                            let imageGallery = [];
                            document.querySelectorAll(".bts-img-trigger img").forEach(img => {
                                imageGallery.push(img.src);
                            });
                            let currentImageIndex = 0;

                            if (prevBtn && nextBtn) {
                                prevBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    currentImageIndex = (currentImageIndex - 1 + imageGallery.length) % imageGallery.length;
                                    mImg.src = imageGallery[currentImageIndex];
                                };
                                nextBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                                    e.stopPropagation();
                                    currentImageIndex = (currentImageIndex + 1) % imageGallery.length;
                                    mImg.src = imageGallery[currentImageIndex];
                                };
                            }

                            document.querySelectorAll(".bts-img-trigger").forEach((el, index) => {
                                el.addEventListener("click", () => {
                                    currentImageIndex = index;
                                    modal.classList.add("active");
                                    mImg.src = imageGallery[currentImageIndex];
                                    mImg.style.display = "block";
                                    mVid.pause(); mVid.src = ""; mVid.style.display = "none";
                                    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";

                                    if (imageGallery.length > 1) {
                                        if (prevBtn) prevBtn.style.display = "flex";
                                        if (nextBtn) nextBtn.style.display = "flex";
                                    }
                                });
                            });

                            document.querySelectorAll(".bts-video-trigger").forEach(el => {
                                el.addEventListener("click", () => {
                                    modal.classList.add("active");
                                    mVid.src = el.dataset.src;
                                    mVid.style.display = "block";
                                    mVid.play();
                                    mImg.src = ""; mImg.style.display = "none";
                                    document.body.style.overflow = "hidden";
                                    hideArrows();
                                });
                            });
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(err => console.error('Error fetching BTS:', err));

            // 4. Tab Switching Logic
            const btsTabs = document.querySelectorAll('.bts-t-btn');
            btsTabs.forEach(btn => {
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    btsTabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                    btn.classList.add('active');
                    const target = btn.dataset.target;
                    document.querySelectorAll('.bts-panel').forEach(p => {
                        p.style.display = 'none';
                        p.classList.remove('active');
                    });
                    const targetPanel = document.getElementById(target);
                    if (targetPanel) {
                        targetPanel.style.display = 'block';
                        setTimeout(() => targetPanel.classList.add('active'), 10);
                    }
                });
            });
        });
    </script>

    <script>
        // Intersection Observer for Videos (Preload only when near)
        const videoObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries, observer) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    const video = entry.target;
                    video.preload = "auto";
                    observer.unobserve(video);
                }
            });
        }, { rootMargin: "200px" });

        document.querySelectorAll('video[preload="metadata"]').forEach(video => {
            videoObserver.observe(video);
        });

        // REVEAL ON SCROLL
        const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                    revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
                }
            });
        }, { threshold: 0.1 });

        document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]').forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));
    </script>
